checks.name: Invoice poller
checks.detail: reads the accounts@ inbox every 30 min
checks.meaning: Reads the supplier-bills inbox on the office Mac every 30 minutes.
checks.action: Check the office Mac is on and awake - it resumes on its own and no bills are lost. Still red an hour after it is awake? Tell Zak.
checks.selfheal: Recovers by itself once the Mac is awake.

checks.name: Xero approvals poller
checks.meaning: Posts approved supplier bills into Xero every couple of minutes (office Mac).
checks.action: Same office-Mac job - check it is awake. Approvals just wait until it runs; nothing is lost.
checks.selfheal: Recovers once the Mac is awake.

checks.name: Xero token
checks.meaning: The Xero login the finance jobs use, refreshed automatically each day.
checks.action: Expired - Zak needs to re-log-in to Xero on the Mac. Wages and COGS keep showing the last good data until then.
checks.selfheal: No - needs Zak to re-authenticate Xero.

checks.name: Weekly Xero pull
checks.meaning: Pulls payroll and overheads from Xero once a week.
checks.action: Behind - the weekly Xero pull needs re-running (needs the Mac and Zak's Xero login). Rarely urgent.
checks.selfheal: Catches up on the next weekly run.

checks.name: Daily sales pull
checks.meaning: Yesterday's Lightspeed sales landing in the dashboard.
checks.action: Usually the Stowaway sales email has not arrived yet. It retries every 20 min until ~10am. Still missing after 10am? Ask Claude to check the Stow export landed and re-run the ingest, or tell Zak. Numbers fill in once it arrives.
checks.selfheal: Retries through the morning; often fixes itself before 10am.

checks.name: Xero COGS feed
checks.meaning: Weekly actual cost-of-goods from Xero (drives the margin figures).
checks.action: The weekly Xero pull is behind - see 'Weekly Xero pull'. Margins show the last good week meanwhile.
checks.selfheal: Catches up with the weekly Xero pull.

checks.name: Xero overheads feed
checks.meaning: Monthly overheads from Xero (rent, utilities and the like).
checks.action: Run the Xero pull to refresh. Benign early in a new month before it is closed.
checks.selfheal: Catches up with the monthly Xero pull.

checks.name: Pull integrity
checks.meaning: Marilyna's sales are carved from the Stow till and cross-checked against her own Lightspeed report.
checks.action: Minor: on 2026-08-08 a few Marilyna's rows weren't in her Lightspeed report, so the filter drifted slightly. The revenue is still attributed - this is a nudge to tidy the 'Mari Daily Sales Auto' report in Lightspeed when convenient, not an outage.
checks.selfheal: Clears on its own once a clean day aggregates; only needs a Lightspeed fix if it keeps recurring.

checks.name: Sales completeness
checks.detail: every venue's recent trading days have sales
